name: High-intensity statin
notes: LDL pathway credited through the CTT per-mmol relationship

name: Moderate-intensity statin
notes: Alternative intensity for intolerance scenarios

name: Ezetimibe
notes: Add-on benefit demonstrated in IMPROVE-IT

name: Bempedoic acid
notes: Outcomes evidence in statin-intolerant patients

name: Evolocumab
notes: Trough-to-peak LDL variation modelled explicitly

name: Alirocumab
notes: Recent-ACS outcomes population

name: Inclisiran
notes: Twice-yearly dosing; hard outcomes pending

name: Enlicitide oral macrocyclic peptide
mechanism: Oral macrocyclic peptide blocking PCSK9-LDLR binding
notes: FDA approved 2026-07-16 for LDL-C; fasting administration; outcomes pending

name: AZD0780 oral small molecule
notes: Phase 2b efficacy; no fasting restriction; phase 3 outcomes recruiting

name: VERVE-102 PCSK9 base editing
mechanism: Single-infusion adenine base editing of PCSK9 splice site
notes: Phase 1 n=35; durability modelled as permanent only as a scenario; long-term safety unknown

name: Pelacarsen
notes: Lp(a)HORIZON failed its primary 4-point MACE endpoint (2026-09-04) despite ~80% Lp(a) reduction; retained as a neutral negative control for the Lp(a) hypothesis.

name: Olpasiran
notes: Lp(a) outcome trials ongoing; no outcomes credit

name: Muvalaplin
mechanism: Oral small-molecule disruptor of apo(a)-apoB assembly
notes: Phase 2 Lp(a) lowering only

name: Low-dose colchicine
notes: Population-dependent: positive in LoDoCo2 and COLCOT but neutral in CLEAR SYNERGY

name: Canakinumab
notes: Requires inflammatory enrichment; infection risk and cost-effectiveness limits

name: Ziltivekimab
notes: Large hsCRP reduction but neutral MACE in ZEUS; biomarker change must not create benefit

name: Low-dose methotrexate
mechanism: Broad anti-inflammatory without IL-6 pathway engagement
notes: Negative control: no biomarker change and no event reduction in CIRT

name: Selective NLRP3 inhibitor
notes: Hypothetical biomarker effect only; no outcomes evidence

name: Semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly
mechanism: GLP-1 receptor agonism with weight and metabolic effects
notes: Outcomes benefit shown in obesity with ASCVD and without diabetes

name: Empagliflozin
notes: MACE evidence in type 2 diabetes with ASCVD

name: SGLT2 inhibitor for heart failure
notes: Endpoint is heart-failure composite and is never credited as MACE

name: Blood-pressure intensification
mechanism: Additional antihypertensive therapy to lower systolic pressure
notes: Credited per 5 mmHg systolic reduction from individual-participant meta-analysis

name: Aspirin secondary prevention
notes: Background secondary prevention with a bleeding trade-off not modelled here

name: Icosapent ethyl
notes: Comparator controversy means the effect size is contested

name: Smoking cessation
notes: Observational mortality association; confounding cannot be excluded

name: Exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation
notes: Mortality and admission endpoints rather than a MACE composite

name: LDL-lowering dietary pattern
notes: Surrogate LDL effect; no dedicated outcome trial

name: PCI for stable coronary disease
notes: Angina relief without event reduction in stable disease

name: CABG for ischaemic cardiomyopathy
notes: Extended-follow-up mortality endpoint rather than a MACE composite

name: iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte sheet
notes: Eight-patient uncontrolled pivotal data; never credited with MACE or mortality benefit

name: Obicetrapib 10 mg
notes: BROADWAY n=2530 LDL-C -29.9% (NEJM); events HR 0.79 (0.54-1.15) not powered. PREVAIL (n=9541) primary completion Nov 2026.

name: CTX310 ANGPTL3 CRISPR editing
mechanism: One-time in vivo Cas9 loss-of-function editing of hepatic ANGPTL3
notes: Phase 1a n=15, 0.8 mg/kg: ANGPTL3 -79%, LDL-C -53%, TG -48% sustained to 1 year (ESC 2026). No outcomes data.

name: Lepodisiran
notes: ALPACA: ~94% time-averaged Lp(a) reduction. ACCLAIM-Lp(a) n=17300, readout ~2029.

name: Zerlasiran
notes: Phase 2 >80% time-averaged Lp(a) reduction over 36 weeks; phase 3-ready, no active outcomes trial.

name: Plozasiran (APOC3 siRNA)
notes: SHASTA-3/4 n=757: TG -79/-81%, non-HDL-C -28/-38%, acute pancreatitis RR 0.22. Triglyceride/pancreatitis indication, not MACE.

name: Olezarsen (APOC3 ASO)
notes: CORE-TIMI 72a/72b: placebo-adjusted TG up to -72%, pancreatitis -85%; hepatic fat and platelet signals. No MACE data.

name: Tirzepatide
notes: SURPASS-CVOT n=13299 vs ACTIVE comparator dulaglutide: MACE-3 HR 0.92 (0.83-1.01), non-inferior only. Not a placebo-relative effect. SBP value is the between-arm difference vs dulaglutide (6.2 vs 4.1 mmHg).

name: Retatrutide
notes: Phase 2: weight -28.7%, SBP -14 mmHg at 12 mg. No cardiovascular outcomes trial result yet.

name: DFV890 (selective NLRP3 inhibitor)
notes: Phase 2a in CAD with TET2/DNMT3A clonal haematopoiesis; no outcomes data.

name: Genotype-guided canakinumab (TET2-CHIP)
mechanism: IL-1beta blockade restricted to TET2 clonal-haematopoiesis carriers
notes: CANTOS exploratory genomic substudy: TET2 carriers (n=103) HR ~0.38. Post-hoc, not prospectively randomised by genotype.

name: YAP101 (AAV9-SAV1-shRNA)
mechanism: Cardiomyocyte-restricted Hippo pathway release to trigger proliferation
notes: SALVADOR-HF NCT06831825 started June 2026; first-in-human cardiac regeneration gene therapy. Pig MI model EF +14%; no human efficacy data.

name: BioVAT engineered heart muscle patch
mechanism: Epicardial iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte/stromal tissue for remuscularisation
notes: BioVAT-HF NEJM 2026, n=20 (16 max dose): wall thickness +4.5 mm, LVEF +3.9 pp, KCCQ +6.7 at 3 months; 3 deaths and 3 VT judged unrelated; requires immunosuppression.

name: Autologous CD34+ cell therapy
mechanism: Pro-angiogenic cell delivery to ischaemic myocardium/microvasculature
notes: Randomised trials show angina/exercise and coronary flow reserve improvement; mortality signal is pooled/post-hoc. Symptom endpoint only.

name: Coronary sinus reducer
mechanism: Controlled coronary sinus narrowing to redistribute perfusion
notes: REMEDY-PILOT (TCT 2026, n=54, ANOCA/CMD): no benefit vs sham on perfusion reserve, angina or QoL. Angina-only device.

name: PCSK9 peptide vaccine (AT04A-class)
notes: Mouse LDL-C -29% at 4 weeks, -20% at 14 weeks; rhesus macaques showed antibody response but NO lipid change. Animal-only: never transported to human event credit.

name: CAR-Treg against oxidised LDL
mechanism: Antigen-specific regulatory T cells restoring tolerance to oxLDL
notes: 2026 proof of concept: reduced foam-cell formation in vitro and limited plaque in mice. Treats atherosclerosis as an autoimmune disease; no human data.

name: AB-1002 / umiposgene parvec
mechanism: Intracoronary AAV delivery of constitutively active inhibitor-1 (I-1c)
notes: GenePHIT n=173 enrols NON-ISCHAEMIC cardiomyopathy only; results H1 2027. Not transportable to ischaemic disease.
